title: Anima v0.6.0 — bring a torch, chop a tree, find your party
content:
Britannia has a proper night again. Anima v0.6.0 brings darkness, carried lights, harvesting fixes, and more ways to keep your party and your interface in view.

## Bring a torch

Torches and street lamps light the ground, carried lights follow your character, and walls can block their glow. Dusk, night, and dungeon darkness now render correctly.

## Work with the world

Trees and cave floors can be targeted for harvesting. The release fixes how static targets and terrain data reach the server.

## Keep your party in sight

Party and guild positions appear on the map, including members beyond your immediate view.

## Make the interface yours

Build macro sequences with delays and target waits, bind actions to the mouse or wheel, keep name plates visible, and pin health bars. Right-click window closing, context menus, Alt-click follow, and corpse auto-opening make everyday play easier.

The screenshots below were captured in Anima on a live ServUO shard.

**Available for Apple Silicon Macs and Windows x64.** Bring your own Ultima Online game files and shard account. Read the complete release notes for validation details and known limits.
